{{Quote|I think General Dodonna is quite the tactician.|[[Cesi Eirriss]]|<ref name="Empire 12">[[Empire 12|''Empire'' 12]]</ref>}}
'''Jan Dodonna''' was a [[human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was one of the first captains of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], having served in both the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following his defection in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he became one of the first [[General/Legends|generals]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]], overseeing the Rebel victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He was thought dead in amidst the chaos of the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], but instead he had been captured by the Empire and was imprisoned in the notorious ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' facility. He was liberated in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], and he then resumed service with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] until his retirement, where he lived out the rest of his life in [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Aldera]], [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Aldeeran]], until his subsequent death in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].

Throughout his long period of service, Dodonna showed a strong grasp of tactics and strategy, and along with [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], Dodonna was considered the authority on modern space combat.

==Biography==
===Serving the Republic (&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]])===
{{Quote|Blind obedience is not good service. I pledged to serve the ''principles'' of the Republic&mdash;not an office.|Jan Dodonna, to [[Jace Dallin]]|<ref name="Republic 70">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>}}
[[File:Screed_and_Dodonna.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Terrinald Screed and Jan Dodonna receive the Holt Cross on Anaxes.]]
Jan Dodonna was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the planet of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. He began his military career in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]],<ref name="EGW" /> serving as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the crew of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Ardent IV]]'' during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]].<ref name="NEGC" /> Dodonna held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and first rose to prominence during the conflict,<ref name="EGW" /> becoming one of the finest [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] captains in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="FUCG" /> Alongside his fellow captain [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], Dodonna commanded the two task forces that comprised the [[Victory Fleet]].<ref name="NEC" />

After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Bulwark Fleet]] [[Battle of Foerost (Clone Wars)|broke through]] the Republic's [[Foerost Siege|blockade]] of [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20.1 BBY]], Dodonna and Screed clashed with Bulwark Fleet commander [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]] at [[Battle of Ixtlar (Clone Wars)|Ixtlar]], [[Battle of Basilisk (Clone Wars)|Basilisk]], and [[Battle of Alsakan (Clone Wars)|Alsakan]]. In the climactic [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]],<ref name="NEC" /> Dodonna cornered [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Ningo<ref name="EGW" /> and came under heavy fire in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].<ref name="NEC" /> Dodonna fought furiously, engaging Ningo's [[Warship/Legends|warships]] long enough to allow Screed to emerge from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and destroy Ningo's [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] [[Unrepentant (Bulwark Mark I)|''Unrepentant'']].<ref name="EGW" /> Dodonna and Screed both returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as heroes,<ref name="NEC" /> and Dodonna was awarded the [[Holt Cross]] on Anaxes three weeks after the battle he had fought there. As he traversed the [[Azure Walk]], Dodonna physically supported his fellow honoree Screed, who had suffered nearly-mortal injuries in the battle at Anaxes.<ref name="EGW" />

Dodonna, along with [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], was later a member of the Republic negotiating team during the [[Battle of Rendili]]. Several months later he commanded the Republic fleet at the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

Dodonna's grasp of strategy was particularly keen, and along with his old friend and fellow Republic officer [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], Dodonna revolutionized the tactics of space combat. While Tallon's skill was in ship-to-ship warfare, Dodonna's expertise lay in logistics and siege tactics. He proposed a number of siege weapons, proposals later adopted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for their use in such operations as the [[Siege of Dalron Five]] and [[Project Asteroid]].<ref name="MTSB">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Sometime during the war, he served alongside [[Nejaa Halcyon]]. He also convinced his old friend, [[Sagoro Autem]], to quit his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] ways and join the Navy.<ref name="Loyalties">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]]</ref>

===Serving the Empire ([[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&ndash;[[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]])===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''You'' are now the hero of Saleucami, just as ''I'' am retroactively the hero of Rendili. There are no Jedi heroes. ''That'' is the new order of things.|Jan Dodonna, to [[Sagoro Autem]]|<ref name="Loyalties" />}}
As the Republic became the Galactic Empire, Dodonna served loyally for some time, even advising Autem to keep quiet about his feelings on the alleged "Jedi Rebellion."<ref name="Honor and Duty">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Honor and Duty]]''</ref> When the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]] began in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] managed to reactivate a droid army in the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]]. Dodonna and his future fellow defector Admiral [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] were given command of the force to suppress it.<ref name="EGW" />

Deployed from [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]], Tallon and Dodonna led the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] in several months of [[Battle of Diado|attritional fighting]] on the world of [[Diado]]. After reducing Toora's forces there, they subsequently won another [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|victory]] at [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], before [[Siege of Sy Myrth|besieging]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] itself. Under Dodonna's expert guidance, the Empire eventually defeated the Separatists there. Tallon and Dodonna then chased down Toora's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Defiance's Banner]]'', with a task force led by the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']]. The end of the campaign came in the [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene system]], after the Imperial task force cornered Toora's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] there. In the [[Battle of Trasemene|ensuing battle]], the ''Battalion'' ripped apart Toora's fleet with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Toora and ending the insurrection.<ref name="EGW" />

Dodonna and Tallon's victories were celebrated in the Core Worlds, but Dodonna's loyalty to the Empire gradually became tested as it resorted to ever-more brutal acts of reprisal against purported sedition. Though he disliked what the Imperial regime was becoming, Dodonna's loyalty as a soldier led him to refuse to speak ill of it. Furthermore, he regarded the fledgling Rebel Alliance as a foolish provocation that would only cause chaos and misery.<ref name="EGW" /> Disillusioned and unhappy, Dodonna eventually retired from the service on ideological grounds. The Empire, in turn, gave the famous war hero Commenor's moon [[Brelor]], where he spent many years raising his son [[Vrad Dodonna|Vrad]].<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

===Rebel ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]])===
{{Quote|The target area is only two meters wide. It's a small thermal exhaust port right below the main port. The shaft leads directly to the reactor system. A precise hit will start a chain reaction which should destroy the station.|Jan Dodonna instructing Rebel pilots, prior to the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Dodonna refused [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] many offers for him to join her fledgling resistance movement, an act he considered [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]].<ref name="NEGC" /> However, [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] officials deemed him a poor candidate for "retraining" for the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] use, and around 2 BBY<ref name="Darklighter">According to the entry for [[Soontir Fel]] in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', this event occurs two years after the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]]. However, later sources shifted the battle’s date to [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. Works published around the same time as Characters, such as ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', instead placed the battle in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], which aligns with the timeline presented in [[Empire 8|''Star Wars: Empire'' issue 8]], depicting the mutiny shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. More recent references, including ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', ultimately standardized the Battle of Nar Shaddaa as occurring in 4 BBY.</ref>, deciding he was less potentially dangerous dead, ordered his assassination.<ref name="MTSB" /><ref name="NEGC" /><ref name="The Short, Happy Life of Roons Sewell">''[[Star Wars: Empire: The Short, Happy Life of Roons Sewell]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] learned of the assassination order, and sent a messenger team led by [[Roons Sewell]] to warn Dodonna. Dodonna scoffed at first, having lost much of his fighting spirit after years of retirement, and the team set up to leave. However, the arrival of the assassins re-awakened that spirit, and Dodonna fled. The Imperial troopers fired upon him, but the large target of his billowing nightclothes obscured the small, frail body hidden inside, and none of the shots found its mark. He arrived at the Rebels' ship and boarded just as it was preparing to leave.<ref name="MTSB" /><ref name="EGW" /><ref name="NEGC" />

In space, the messengers' slow [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was pursued by an Imperial warship. Dodonna suggested a course of action to General Sewell, but in the heat of the moment, Sewell froze, and Dodonna took the controls of the vessel, executing his tactic and destroying the opposing vessel.<ref name="The Short, Happy Life of Roons Sewell" />

[[File:Jan_Dodonna.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jan Dodonna]]
Dodonna joined the Rebellion and, after Sewell provided a glowing report of Dodonna's quick thinking, was immediately commissioned to [[General/Legends|General]] by Mon Mothma and placed under Sewell's command.<ref name="The Short, Happy Life of Roons Sewell" /> He spent several months exercising and acquainting himself with the latest in technology and politics.<ref name="MTSB" /> His first major victory was at the [[Silken Asteroids]], where he successfully coordinated the defense of a small Rebel base against Imperial incursion.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

After the untimely death of General Sewell, Dodonna was placed in command of the [[Logistics and Supply Corps/Legends|Logistics and Supply Corps]] and the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]],<ref name="EGW" /><ref name="NEGC" /> becoming the most important military commander and advisor in the Alliance, second only to Mon Mothma herself.<ref name="MTSB" /> He also had responsibility for the Alliance's [[High Command Base|ground headquarters]], and kept the ground HQ in motion so as to avoid Imperial detection; planets that held the base under his command included [[Chrellis]], [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], [[Orion IV]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="NEGC" />

Dodonna's multiple commands came about owing to the need for a respected military commander who could broker the three-way tensions between Mon Mothma, [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. A proponent of the largely-unfashionable view that the [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] should be a separate branch of the military, Dodonna believed that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] could undermine the Empire's control of space. He demonstrated this with [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] raids that destroyed [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleets at [[Battle of Denab|Denab]] and [[Battle of Tarawa|Tarawa]]. Thereafter, finding suitable targets for starfighters became the priority for [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], while Dodonna geared [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] and the [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]] to providing the materiel and men for raiding.<ref name="EGW" />

During his time in the Alliance High Command on Dantooine, Dodonna performed different field missions with tactics prodigy [[Risiev Credal]], who was his protégée alongside [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Beryl Chiffonage]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> With the help of [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]], designer of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], Dodonna modified the [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] into the fast, nimble [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighter]]; the first prototypes saw action before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], though the final version would include lessons about the value of raw speed learned during that battle.<ref name="NEGC" /><ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|generaljandodonna|Dodonna, General Jan}}</ref> He began work on the [[Battle Analysis Computer]], which became so identified with him that it was often called "Dodonna's Battle Analysis Computer"; it would go uncompleted until just after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], seeing its first use at the [[Invasion of Bakura]].<ref name="NEGC" /><ref name="TABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> His son Vrad also joined the Alliance, and become a starfighter pilot.<ref name="NEGC" />

[[File:Medals.png|thumb|left|250px|Dodonna at the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]] presentation ceremony]]
With plans brought to him by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] which were downloaded from [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Dodonna helped plan the attack on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" /> At first, the situation seemed hopeless, as the station's defenses exceeded Dodonna's worst fears; the only strategy he could conceive that stood any chance was crashing wave after wave of the Alliance's heaviest vessels into the station, on the slim chance there would be sufficient damage to neutralize it; this would effectively destroy the Rebellion, but would allow a new one to grow without the Death Star threatening them. Dodonna prepared to go to sleep, but instead wandered the halls for fresh air. While doing so, he encountered a small child, weeping over a nightmare about a dragon coming to burn her village. Dodonna comforted her with an old tale of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] finding a hole in the dragon's scaly armor, killing it. Inspired, Dodonna ran back to his quarters and scoured the plans for a similar hole, eventually finding one in the form of a small exposed [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] that led directly to the main reactor.<ref name="MTSB" /> The data showed that the defenses of the Death Star were built around large-scale attacks, allowing a small starfighter to attack the vulnerable exhaust port. Dodonna designed the starfighter attack that was successful in destroying the battle station, and briefed the Rebel pilots prior to the assault on the battlestation.<ref name="ANH" /> Shortly afterwards, he was called in to deal with the short-lived [[super-vaporator]] project on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], though this soon fell through, and he returned to Yavin.<ref name="TMOTRR">''[[The Mystery of the Rebellious Robot]]''</ref>

===Captive ([[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]&ndash;[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])===
[[File:DarthjaVuder-SWGB.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Dodonna is captured by Darth Vader following the Battle of Yavin.]]
Following the destruction of the Death Star, the Empire [[Yavin blockade|blockaded]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] while [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] waited for the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] to be completed. When it was, Vader brought it to finish the Rebels, but was stopped by a suicide strike delivered by Vrad. Heartbroken, Jan set up the Yavin base to explode, taking out a number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and buying more time for the evacuation. He was believed to be killed in the blast, but in reality he had been captured by Imperial forces.<ref name="Krytos">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

He was eventually sent to ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''. The Imperials were unable to turn him into a [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]]. Dodonna spent several years at ''Lusankya'', becoming the leader of the prisoners there. Dodonna later encountered [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], a member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], and aided in Horn's escape, saving him from the [[General/Legends|general]] [[Evir Derricote]]. When offered to join him in freedom, he declined, saying [[Ysanne Isard]] would take it out on the other prisoners. He stayed at ''Lusankya'' until he was moved by Isard. Eventually, Rogue Squadron found the surviving ''Lusankya'' prisoners, and Dodonna was finally freed.<ref name="Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

===Elder Statesman ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]&ndash;[[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]])===
After being freed, Dodonna served on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] council, and gathered together an ad-hoc advisory body consisting of himself and other such aged luminaries as [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]], [[Pashna Starkiller]], and his old friend [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. Calling themselves the "[[Gray Cadre/Legends|Gray Cadre]]," they advised the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the resurgence of the Empire under the clone of Palpatine.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

After the defeat of the cloned Emperor, Dodonna was given a special appointment to the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council's]] [[New Republic High Command/Legends|High Command]] as "Executive Advisor", where he adopted the issue of re-integrating [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] feral [[Human/Legends|Humans]] into society.<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Shortly afterward, Dodonna returned to retirement, settling on [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], where he peacefully passed away prior to the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NEGC" />

===Legacy===
[[File:Dodonnas_Pride_SWA.png|thumb|left|220px|The CR90 corvette ''Dodonna's Pride'']]
Dodonna's strategic acumen was sorely missed by New Republic leaders during the Yuuzhan Vong War, though many of them were relieved that he had died knowing a galaxy at peace.<ref name="EGW" /> The Rebellion named a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Dodonna's Pride/Legends|''Dodonna's Pride'']] in his honor.<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW|set=Tantive IV Expansion Pack|cardname=''Dodonna's Pride''}} & {{Armada|set=Core Set|cardname=''Dodonna's Pride''}}</ref> It was used to disrupt Imperial supply lines during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="YJKCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=''Dodonna's Pride''|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/73RRdodonnaspride.html}}</ref> The [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] later named a [[Galactic-class battle carrier|''Galactic''-class battle carrier]] [[Dodonna (Galactic-class)|''Dodonna'']] in his memory.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:General_Jan_Dodonna_NEC.jpg|thumb|General Jan Dodonna]]
Jan Dodonna's only film appearance was in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], where he was played by [[Alex McCrindle]]. He was voiced by [[James Blendick]] in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]], [[Clive Revill]] in the special edition of the game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], [[Jarion Monroe]] in the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', and [[Wayne Grace]] in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''. Dodonna is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' during the Rebel campaign and was intended to be a playable character, but was cut.

In [[The Star Wars first draft|''The Star Wars: First Draft'']], [[George Lucas]] renamed a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knight character "Dodona" from [[Espaa Valorum|Valorum]], as he considered, in that draft alone, renaming the Starkiller family the "Valor" family, and the names conflicted. "Dodona" was one of the few names from that draft that reappeared in the [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars]] (the second draft), when it was definitively assigned to a Rebel general on Yavin 4.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>
